tagline.en: A camera-controlled world model — generate and edit video along a specified camera trajectory, grounded in 3D geometry.
tagline.zh: 一个相机可控的世界模型——沿指定相机轨迹生成与编辑视频，并以 3D 几何为基础。

en: Spatia is a world model that generates video under explicit camera control. Rather than leaving camera motion to chance, you specify a trajectory and the model produces frames that follow it, keeping the scene spatially consistent as the viewpoint moves.

It combines a video generation backbone (built on Wan2.2-TI2V-5B) with a geometry component from MapAnything, which supplies dense scene structure so that camera paths can be expressed as world-to-camera trajectories. This lets it support camera-controlled video and video-to-video editing along a chosen path.

In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared pipeline — provide the inputs and a camera trajectory, and it writes out a video that follows that path. The bundled source is required, and the default MapAnything geometry checkpoint carries a research-only CC-BY-NC-4.0 license.
zh: Spatia 是一个在显式相机控制下生成视频的世界模型。相机运动不再随机，而是由你指定一条轨迹，模型生成沿该轨迹推进的画面，并在视角移动时保持场景的空间一致性。
它将视频生成骨干（基于 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B）与来自 MapAnything 的几何组件相结合，后者提供稠密的场景结构，使相机路径可以用 world-to-camera 轨迹来表达。由此它支持相机可控视频以及沿指定路径的视频到视频编辑。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你通过统一 pipeline 运行它——提供输入与相机轨迹，它就会输出一段沿该路径推进的视频。运行需要随附的源码，且默认的 MapAnything 几何 checkpoint 采用仅限研究的 CC-BY-NC-4.0 许可。

whenToUse.en: When you want video generation or editing with explicit camera control — following a chosen trajectory through a scene while keeping geometry consistent.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想在显式相机控制下进行视频生成或编辑——沿指定轨迹穿过场景、同时保持几何一致时。

notFor.en: Commercial use of the default geometry component — the MapAnything checkpoint is research-only under CC-BY-NC-4.0. Weights are downloaded separately, so plan for the download.
notFor.zh: 不适合将默认几何组件用于商业用途——MapAnything checkpoint 采用仅限研究的 CC-BY-NC-4.0 许可。权重需单独下载，请预留下载时间。
